marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind south 15 to 20 knots increasing to west 25 to 30 this
evening except west 35 over southwestern sections. Wind becoming west 20 to 25
early Thursday morning then diminishing to west 10 to 15 early Thursday
afternoon. Scattered showers this evening. Fog patches dissipating
after midnight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre building to 2 to 3 this evening then subsiding to 1
to 2 Thursday morning. Seas subsiding to 1 or less early Thursday
evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Friday: Wind light.<br/>Saturday: Wind southeast 15 knots diminishing to
 light.<br/>Sunday: Wind light.<br/>
